section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种锂离子电池，包括壳体、设于壳体内的正极极片、负极极片和隔离膜，所述正极极片包括铝箔和涂覆于铝箔表面的正极材料，所述铝箔包括第一铝箔层、第二铝箔层和设于第一铝箔层与第二铝箔层之间且可形变拉伸的塑料层。本实用新型解决锂离子电池在使用过程中由于穿刺或挤压而造成内部短路引起热失控过程中，电池的安全性问题。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, including the casing, locate positive pole piece, negative pole piece and barrier film in the casing, positive pole piece includes the aluminium foil and coats in the anodal material on aluminium foil surface, the aluminium foil includes first aluminium foil layer, second aluminium foil layer and locates between first aluminium foil layer and the second aluminium foil layer and the tensile plastic layer of deformation. The utility model provides a lithium ion battery causes the internal short circuit to arouse thermal runaway in-process, the security problem of battery because puncture or extrusion in the use.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the battery field, concretely relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

At present, as the application of lithium ion batteries in electric vehicles and other fields is becoming more and more extensive, the safety accident reports of lithium ion batteries are increasing. Because of its high energy density and the adoption of an organic combustible electrolyte system, lithium ion batteries, when misused or abused, can cause thermal runaway under certain conditions, causing unsafe accidents. Generally, the safety problem of lithium ion batteries is caused by thermal runaway, and various electrochemical reactions occur inside the battery with increasing temperature, which causes a rapid increase in the internal pressure of the battery accompanied by the generation of a large amount of combustible gas while the battery temperature continues to increase.

In general, lithium ion batteries pass various safety performance standards in addition to meeting basic performance requirements such as capacity, charge and discharge performance, cycle performance and the like. The overcharge, short circuit, thermal shock and mechanical shock of lithium ion batteries are all liable to affect the safety of the batteries, but the actions and effects of these factors are different. The most stringent of safety tests are needle stick, short circuit and squeeze.

When the battery is pricked or extruded, particularly when the battery is pricked by external sharp foreign matters to penetrate a battery shell and a separation membrane, internal short circuit of the battery is easily caused, and large current flows in a very short time, so that the internal temperature of the battery is directly and rapidly increased, and a series of violent reactions are caused. Even serious safety problems of burning and explosion occur. Therefore, the research on the safety system of the lithium ion battery with high energy density has become a hot problem in the field of the current lithium ion battery.

The common ways to prevent safety problems such as overcharge, short circuit and thermal shock of lithium ion batteries are mainly internal control and external control. The general mode of internal protection is that the shrinkage and the closed pore of the thermosensitive pressure-sensitive isolating membrane are utilized when the thermosensitive pressure-sensitive isolating membrane is overheated, so that ions are prevented from entering and exiting the anode material and the cathode material; adding a safety additive into the electrolyte; doping or cladding enables the structure of the anode and cathode materials to be more stable when thermal runaway. The external protection measures mainly comprise that a safety valve, a Positive Temperature Coefficient (PTC) resistance element, a special electronic circuit and an external circuit are additionally arranged on a single lithium battery, and the special electronic circuit and the external circuit are pre-embedded in the single lithium battery to monitor the charging and discharging processes of the battery pack.

The external control methods have certain prevention effect on overcharge, thermal shock and other safety hazards, but have no effect on handling potential safety hazards such as extrusion, acupuncture and the like; the conventional internal measures are often not significant enough in effect, and the problem of battery safety cannot be thoroughly solved. Particularly, when the battery case is subjected to an extremely severe short circuit condition such as external needling and extrusion, the local deformation part rises to a maximum temperature within a very short time, and releases a large amount of heat energy while the temperature exceeds the reaction temperature of the active material, and finally the battery case is burnt violently and even explodes. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a safety protection mechanism, which can quickly react when the lithium ion battery is subjected to a needle-punching or other situations, so as to avoid potential safety hazards caused by the battery.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model discloses aim at solving the technical problem who exists among the prior art. Therefore, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, the purpose improves the battery structure, improves lithium ion battery's extrusion and puncture resistance.

In order to realize the purpose, the utility model discloses the technical scheme who takes does:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes the casing, locates positive pole piece, negative pole piece and barrier film in the casing, positive pole piece includes the aluminium foil and coats in the anodal material on aluminium foil surface, the aluminium foil includes first aluminium foil layer, second aluminium foil layer and locates between first aluminium foil layer and the second aluminium foil layer and the tensile plastic layer of deformation.

The plastic layer is a PP plastic layer, a PE plastic layer, a PET plastic layer, a PPA plastic layer, a PI plastic layer, a PPS plastic layer or a PEEK plastic layer.

The aluminum foil is of a sandwich structure.

The negative pole piece comprises a copper foil and a negative pole material coated on the surface of the copper foil.

The isolating membrane comprises a polyethylene porous membrane layer and polyolefin fiber non-woven fabric membrane layers arranged on two sides of the polyethylene porous membrane layer, and micropores are formed in the polyethylene porous membrane layer.

And a ceramic particle layer is arranged on the outer side of the polyolefin fiber non-woven fabric membrane layer.

The thickness of the aluminum foil is between 8 and 20 mu m.

The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model provides a lithium ion battery causes the internal short circuit to arouse thermal runaway in-process, the security problem of battery because puncture or extrusion in the use. The interlayer aluminum foil is used for the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery, when the battery is punctured or extruded to damage the isolation film and the pole piece, the interlayer aluminum foil can be stretched, and the plastic layer is mainly stretched in the stretching process due to the fact that the tensile strength of the plastic layer in the middle of the interlayer aluminum foil is greater than that of the outer aluminum foil, and the plastic layer penetrates through the isolation film to be in contact with the negative electrode. The plastic layer adopts PP plastic layer, PE plastic layer, PET plastic layer, PPA plastic layer, PI plastic layer, PPS plastic layer or PEEK plastic layer, has good electrical insulation and can not cause the inside short circuit of battery when leading to it to contact with the negative pole, fundamentally stops the production of battery thermal runaway. Simultaneously, tensile PP plastic layer, PE plastic layer, PET plastic layer, PPA plastic layer, PI plastic layer, PPS plastic layer or PEEK plastic layer also can wrap up on the surface of puncture foreign matter for the battery can not cause the battery short circuit because of the positive negative pole of foreign matter connection when the puncture foreign matter is the conductor, arouses thermal runaway. The utility model discloses can obviously improve lithium ion battery and prevent acupuncture and extruded ability.

Detailed Description

The following detailed description of the embodiments of the present invention will be given with reference to the accompanying drawings, for the purpose of helping those skilled in the art to understand more completely, accurately and deeply the conception and technical solution of the present invention, and to facilitate its implementation. It should be noted that the terms "upper", "lower", "front", "rear", "left", "right", "vertical", "inner", "outer", etc. indicate orientations or positional relationships based on the orientations or positional relationships shown in the drawings, and are only for convenience of describing the present invention and simplifying the description, but do not indicate or imply that the device or element referred to must have a specific orientation, be constructed in a specific orientation, and be operated, and thus should not be construed as limiting the present invention. In the following embodiments, the terms "first" and "second" do not denote an absolute structural and/or functional distinction or a sequential order of execution, but are merely used for convenience of description.

As shown in fig. 1 to 2, a lithium ion battery comprises a casing 4, a positive electrode plate, a negative electrode plate and an isolating membrane 7 arranged in the casing 4, wherein the positive electrode plate comprises an aluminum foil 9 and a positive electrode material 8 coated on the surface of the aluminum foil 9, and the aluminum foil comprises a first aluminum foil layer 1, a second aluminum foil layer 2 and a deformable stretching plastic layer 3 arranged between the first aluminum foil layer 1 and the second aluminum foil layer 2. The plastic layer is made of a plastic material having high tensile strength, excellent electrical insulation, and resistance such as high temperature resistance. The tensile strength of the plastic layer is higher than that of the outer two layers of aluminum foil. The shell comprises a shell and an auxiliary structural member, and the shell can be an aluminum shell. The negative pole piece comprises a copper foil 5 and a negative pole material 6 coated on the surface of the copper foil 5.

In a preferred embodiment, the plastic layer 3 is a polyethylene terephthalate plastic layer. The aluminum foil is preferably of a sandwich construction. Specifically, a layer of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic is added between two layers of aluminum foil. Polyethylene terephthalate is also commonly called polyester resin, abbreviated as PET, and has high tensile strength, excellent electrical insulation performance, and excellent wear resistance and friction resistance. By adopting the aluminum foil with the sandwich structure, the lithium ion battery has the following action mechanism in improving the puncture-proof or extrusion-proof performance of the battery: the lithium ion battery can lead to the damage of the isolating membrane and the positive and negative pole pieces in the battery when being punctured or extruded, and simultaneously, the aluminum foil or the copper foil can be stretched, the aluminum foil can penetrate through the damaged isolating membrane and directly contact with the negative pole piece to cause short circuit, and the battery thermal runaway is caused by large heat generated by a large amount of current in a short time. The laminated aluminum foil is used as the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery, when the battery is punctured or the isolating membrane and the pole piece are damaged, the laminated aluminum foil can be stretched, the tensile strength of PET in the middle of the laminated aluminum foil is greater than that of the outer layer aluminum foil, so that PET is mainly stretched in the stretching process, and the PET which penetrates through the isolating membrane and contacts with the negative electrode is also PET. The PET has excellent electrical insulation, so that the PET cannot cause internal short circuit of the battery when contacting with the cathode, and the thermal runaway of the battery is fundamentally avoided. Simultaneously, tensile PET also can wrap up on the surface of puncture foreign matter for the battery can not cause the battery short circuit because of the positive negative pole of foreign matter connection when the puncture foreign matter is the conductor, arouses the thermal runaway. Particularly, when the above action mechanism fails to avoid the short circuit in the battery due to various reasons, the aluminum metal layer outside the interlayer aluminum foil PET layer has a much smaller thickness than the common aluminum foil, and the aluminum foil is melted by generating a large amount of heat instantly by a large current during the internal short circuit, thereby interrupting the short circuit point and avoiding the thermal runaway caused by the further heat generation of the battery.

As another preferred embodiment, the plastic layer 3 is a polyphthalamide plastic layer. Specifically, two layers of aluminum foil are bonded together with a middle Polyphthalamide Plastic (PPA). Polyphthalamide plastic is commonly called high-temperature nylon, called PPA for short, and has high tensile strength, excellent electrical insulation performance, excellent high temperature resistance, creep resistance, fatigue resistance, chemical corrosion resistance and other excellent performances. By adopting the aluminum foil with the sandwich structure, the lithium ion battery has the following action mechanism in improving the puncture-proof or extrusion-proof performance of the battery: the lithium ion battery can lead to the damage of the isolating membrane and the positive and negative pole pieces in the battery when being punctured or extruded, and simultaneously, the aluminum foil or the copper foil can be stretched, the aluminum foil can penetrate through the damaged isolating membrane and directly contact with the negative pole piece to cause short circuit, and the battery thermal runaway is caused by large heat generated by a large amount of current in a short time. The positive electrode of the lithium ion battery uses the adhesive coated aluminum foil, when the battery is damaged by needling or extruding the isolation membrane and the pole piece, the adhesive coated aluminum foil can be stretched, PPA is mainly stretched in the stretching process because the tensile strength of PPA in the middle of the interlayer aluminum foil is greater than that of the outer layer aluminum foil, and PPA penetrates through the isolation membrane and is in contact with the negative electrode. The PPA has excellent electrical insulation, so that the PPA does not cause internal short circuit of the battery when contacting with a negative electrode, and fundamentally avoids the generation of thermal runaway of the battery. Meanwhile, the stretched PPA can be wrapped on the surface of the punctured foreign matter, so that the battery cannot be short-circuited to cause thermal runaway due to the fact that the positive electrode and the negative electrode are conducted by the foreign matter when the punctured foreign matter is a conductor.

The specific thickness of the aluminum foil of the sandwich structure and the thickness ratio of each layer may vary according to the production process and product design requirements, and the thickness of the rubberized aluminum foil is usually between 8-20 μm.

As a further improvement, the separator 7 may be a separator that is conventional in the prior art, as shown in fig. 3, and includes a polyethylene porous separator layer 10 and polyolefin fiber non-woven fabric separator layers 11 disposed on both sides of the polyethylene porous separator layer 10, and the polyethylene porous separator layer 10 is provided with micropores 12. The cylindrical micropores are formed in the polyethylene porous diaphragm layer, so that the electrolyte adsorption of the lithium battery diaphragm can be effectively increased, and ions can pass through the lithium battery diaphragm. The problem that poor liquid absorption performance of the lithium battery can lead to low ion permeability is solved. Further, a ceramic particle layer 13 is provided on the outer side of the polyolefin fiber nonwoven fabric separator layer 11. The outer ceramic particle layer further promotes the high temperature resistance of the lithium battery diaphragm, avoids the lithium battery diaphragm from shrinking in size when being heated, and promotes the safety performance of the lithium battery.

The manufacturing process of the lithium ion battery comprises the following steps:

the aluminum foil shown in the attached figure 2 is used as a current collector of a battery anode, anode slurry containing active materials, conductive agents and binders is uniformly coated on two sides of an interlayer aluminum foil, and is assembled and wound into a naked battery core with a cathode pole piece and an isolation film through cold pressing, die cutting and splitting, and then the naked battery core is formed through procedures of aluminum shell entering, welding, high-temperature baking, liquid injection, formation, capacity, grouping and the like. The lithium ion battery does not limit the specific material system of the battery, and can be ternary (nickel cobalt lithium manganate), lithium iron phosphate and other material batteries.

The invention has been described above by way of example with reference to the accompanying drawings. Obviously, the specific implementation of the present invention is not limited by the above-described manner. Various insubstantial improvements are made by adopting the method conception and the technical proposal of the utility model; or without improvement, the above conception and technical solution of the present invention can be directly applied to other occasions, all within the protection scope of the present invention.
